overview: Scaling and polishing is a routine dental procedure that involves removing plaque, tartar (hardened plaque), and surface stains from your teeth. Scaling focuses on cleaning the areas above and below the gumline while polishing smoothens the tooth surfaces, leaving them shiny and less prone to plaque buildup.

faqs.question: Is scaling and polishing painful?
faqs.answer: The procedure is generally painless. However, if your gums are sensitive or inflamed, you may feel slight discomfort. Our dentists ensure your comfort throughout the process.

faqs.question: How often should I get scaling and polishing done?
faqs.answer: It is recommended to get scaling and polishing done every 6 months. However, the frequency may vary depending on your oral health condition.

faqs.question: Will scaling weaken my teeth?
faqs.answer: No, scaling does not weaken your teeth. It removes harmful deposits and helps maintain healthy teeth and gums.

faqs.question: Can scaling and polishing remove deep stains?
faqs.answer: While polishing can remove surface stains, deeper stains may require teeth-whitening treatments.

faqs.question: How long does the procedure take?
faqs.answer: Scaling and polishing usually take 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the extent of tartar buildup.
